findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "demo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_product_info · Private data: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, run_public_demo, submit_demo_feedback · Public sink: prepare_share_draft, submit_demo_feedback · Destructive: run_public_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_product_info · Private data: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, run_public_demo, submit_demo_feedback · Public sink: prepare_share_draft, submit_demo_feedback · Destructive: run_public_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
